purpose: Preserve the causal one-minute bar and eligible SIP transaction path needed to evaluate the already-selected management rule on frozen prospective entry fills without claiming broker execution or portfolio P&L.
hypothesis: A fixed post-decision SIP window will usually reveal whether the frozen half-at-2R, breakeven, first-red-one-minute translation reaches an observable exit while retaining censored and ambiguous cases instead of inventing outcomes.

window_policy.provider_and_bar_window_start: floor each opportunity decision timestamp to its UTC minute
window_policy.window_censoring_behavior: retain open or unavailable; never infer a later exit

capture_semantics.provider_request_failure_behavior: fail the daily capture closed without a partial artifact
capture_semantics.odd_lot_behavior: retain an otherwise-clean odd-lot as transaction evidence only
capture_semantics.same_timestamp_trade_order: stable original provider order through source_sequence
capture_semantics.zero_opportunity_date_behavior: emit a valid zero-request zero-path capture

management_projection.eligible_campaign: exactly one accepted frozen entry fill for the account, scenario, and symbol
management_projection.multiple_entry_or_add_campaign_behavior: management unavailable because add and re-entry translation is outside the frozen child
management_projection.future_transaction_rule: strictly later than the external L1 entry fill timestamp
management_projection.initial_stop: exact accepted ledger entry stop; never widen
management_projection.first_target: actual L1 entry fill plus two times initial per-share risk
management_projection.first_target_action: record a one-half transaction proxy and move the remaining fractional stop to the actual entry fill
management_projection.runner_action: first eligible SIP print after the first completed red one-minute bar or active stop

allowed_inputs: causal Alpaca SIP one-minute bars and trades inside the fixed window

limitations: A SIP transaction print does not establish that the modeled account could fill its quantity at that price.
The capture does not model quotes, spread, queue position, displayed or hidden liquidity, routing, latency, market impact, halts, or broker acknowledgements for exits.
The fixed fifteen-minute signal window censors later management outcomes and cannot be extended after observing a case.
Adds, re-entries, discretionary tape or seller exits, topping tails, buying slowdown, and session-close flattening remain outside this child.
The projection can support descriptive exit alignment but cannot make the account session flat for conditional portfolio evaluation.
next_gate: Capture each registered date before opening retrospective labels, then run the provider-free projection on exact frozen daily account runtimes. Do not add strategy scope before the ten-date acquisition, participation, entry, and descriptive management evidence is assembled.
